title: Set Device Clock
acc_unreadable: Not readable on an access-control terminal — the protocol has no command for asking it what time it holds. Setting the clock below works, and does not depend on knowing the current value.
acc_note_tz: The clock is set to this terminal's own timezone ({{tz}}), so its display and the punches it reports stay consistent. The command is queued and applies when the terminal next polls.
